name: Dr. Sebastian Wernicke
headline: Driving growth & transformation with data & AI | Partner at Oxera | Best-selling author | 3x TED Speaker
summary:
Using data and AI to transform businesses by asking not just "What?" and "How much?", but also "What if?" and "Why?". I guide companies beyond merely being data-driven to building cultures where data sparks innovation, challenges assumptions, and delivers breakthrough results.

As a hands-on practitioner with over 15 years of experience, I have built and led high-performance data teams across Europe and the U.S. Working with a diverse range of clients—from agile startups to government organizations and Fortune 500 corporations—I help organizations generate transformative value by making data a true strategic asset. 

I believe the key to unlocking data’s power lies in understanding human psychology and fostering an evidence-based culture. I enjoy making these often-complex concepts accessible and actionable. 
My TED Talks have reached over 5 million viewers, and I've given invited talks at Stanford, Wharton Unilever, Mars, Red Bull, Hugo Boss, Munich Re and many other interesting places.

My best-selling book "Data Inspired" (German edition) explores how to build a culture of evidence-based decision making. A completely updated English edition is forthcoming in 2026!

company.name: Oxera Consulting LLP
company.tagline: Inspiring better decisions through economics and finance
company.description:
We advise companies, policymakers, regulators and lawyers on any economic issue connected with competition, finance or regulation. We have been doing this for more than 40 years, gathering deep and wide-ranging knowledge as we expand into new sectors. We have a reputation for credibility and integrity among those we advise, and among key decision-makers, such as policymakers, regulators and courts. 

Today we have offices in Amsterdam, Berlin, Brussels, Hamburg, London, Madrid, Milan, Oxford, Paris and Rome, and are able to advise our international clients in a highly flexible way, including providing advice in several other languages. 
 
Driven by curiosity, integrity, and a passion for making a difference, we bring original and impactful perspectives to the biggest questions facing business and society.
